reviewScope: Named same-engine native truth qualification, separate from input blind review and end-to-end agent acceptance. Historical diagnostic reports retain their former zero-qualification status; this report adds the final request-trace/source-binding decision without rewriting them.

checks.qualificationBoundary: PKPM 2027R1.0.1 observed first-order orthogonal positive-X/Y zero-roll beams and vertical positive-Z columns; source inward endpoint cuts only. Explicit custom E/nu and numeric A/J/I compiled/read back; no stress/design/other-section or axis generalization.

finiteShearEvidence.qualificationBasis: Bounded behavioral qualification from independent two-length, six-material and six-numeric-section controls plus complete six-DOF/end-force/equilibrium review of every retained state. No response-fitted material/section/shear parameter and no tolerance change.

checks.supportOrigin: Reconstructed from native member resisting-end wrenches minus explicit point load, not SDK node reaction.
checks.fixedMissingTranslations: Only explicitly named reviewed homogeneous fixed-boundary consequences may be derived; raw SDK -99999 is preserved. Finite pin translations are excluded.
checks.pinRepresentation: Where present: native 1e14 translational springs and zero rotational springs are retained; independent spring-vs-ideal differences quantified, no exact-zero claim.

crossEngineDiagnosticExceptions.treatment: Original native values and frozen tolerances retained. Native slot/source endpoint identity and equilibrium were independently qualified; the two small cross-engine relative-tolerance differences do not invalidate native truth provenance, and remain diagnostic failures rather than being rounded or replaced.

scopeLimitations: No actual native As scalar readback is claimed.
Raw native values remain finite-precision observations; member-force-derived supports inherit that precision.
The 58 boundary-derived values are not direct SDK observations and retain the complete executed native boundary/DOF evidence plus pin counterexample.
Old built-in C30 control material uncertainty is historical; production runs use separately bound custom native materials.
